capabilities: Embed .xmind files in notes via xmind-pal code blocks, comments, or frontmatter properties
Render mind maps as offline thumbnails extracted from the .xmind file's preview image
Render interactive mind maps via XMind's online embed viewer
Open the .xmind file in its default application for editing from a viewer toolbar
Configure default property name, render mode, region, viewer height, and toolbar behavior
disambiguation: Not a mind mapping tool; it only displays existing .xmind files and does not create or edit mind maps.
extras: Online mode sends .xmind file data to XMind's embed service (xmind.app or xmind.cn) via postMessage; thumbnail mode is fully local. README includes an explicit no-telemetry privacy disclosure.
problem: Obsidian shows .xmind files only as generic attachments and cannot display their mind map content inside a note.

relations.evidence: xmind-embed-viewer (MIT) — XMind embed viewer library by XMind Ltd.

summary: Embeds and previews .xmind mind map files in notes via code blocks, comments, or frontmatter properties, using offline thumbnails or XMind's online viewer.
